invalidation.zh: 失效条件：价格跌破2100（基于ATR 18.88和支撑位），或融资费率Z-score转正（空头风险缓解），或日线趋势转熊（价格跌破SMA50 2042.03）。
invalidation.en: Invalidation condition: Price breaks below 2100 (based on ATR 18.88 and support), or funding Z-score turns positive (short risk eases), or daily trend turns bearish (price < SMA50 2042.03).

invalidation.zh: 失效条件：价格突破73000（基于ATR 533.77和阻力位），或融资费率Z-score降至<50%（拥挤缓解），或日线趋势转熊（价格跌破SMA50 69019.10）。
invalidation.en: Invalidation condition: Price breaks above 73000 (based on ATR 533.77 and resistance), or funding Z-score drops <50% (crowding eases), or daily trend turns bearish (price < SMA50 69019.10).

invalidation.zh: 失效条件：价格跌破0.088（基于ATR 0.001和支撑位），或融资费率Z-score转正（空头风险缓解），或日线趋势转牛（价格突破SMA50 0.10）。
invalidation.en: Invalidation condition: Price breaks below 0.088 (based on ATR 0.001 and support), or funding Z-score turns positive (short risk eases), or daily trend turns bullish (price > SMA50 0.10).
